situation_facts: The multibeam dataset for the Kilbrannan Sound charting job shows a forty centimetre vertical offset in survey lines twelve through nineteen.
The offset was traced to a tide-gauge timestamp mismatch, UTC against British Summer Time, introduced at the ingest step.
The ingest configuration is owned by the software team, led by Runa Halvorsen.
Tobias's remit is post-processing quality control; he has read access to the ingest configuration but no write access and no authority to change it.
Tobias detected the offset during routine crossline QC on 12 August and raised it the same day.
Reprocessing the eight affected lines takes six hours of compute once the configuration is corrected.
The deliverable to the hydrographic office is due 21 August.
The software team has a two-day standard turnaround for configuration defects.
Whether to reprocess in-house or return the job to the software team is Aoife's decision.
Aoife is the sole interface to the client on this job.

turns.input_raw: This is the email I am about to send Aoife, screenshot attached. Anything I should change?
